vakeApartment.title: Vake Apartment Remont
vakeApartment.summary: A full-apartment renovation in the heart of Vake — modern, warm, and family-ready.
vakeApartment.description1: We took a tired Soviet-era 95 m² apartment in Vake and rebuilt it for a young family — opening up the kitchen-living area, replacing every utility line, and finishing in warm oak, white plaster, and brushed brass.
vakeApartment.description2: All work was completed in eleven weeks while the family lived elsewhere. Final cleaning included — they walked into a fully furnished, ready-to-live home.

loftKitchen.title: Loft Kitchen Renovation
loftKitchen.summary: An open-plan loft kitchen with custom oak cabinetry and a 4-meter island.
loftKitchen.description1: The owners wanted a kitchen that could host twelve people for dinner without feeling cramped. We pulled down a non-load-bearing wall, ran a 4-meter island down the new center line, and built every cabinet to a millimeter.
loftKitchen.description2: Stone countertops, soft-close drawers, integrated lighting, and a vented hood that actually vents — not the wall-decoration kind. Delivered in seven weeks.

spaBathroom.title: Spa-Style Bathroom Makeover
spaBathroom.summary: A 14 m² bathroom turned into a private spa — heated stone, walk-in rain shower, freestanding tub.
spaBathroom.description1: The brief: a bathroom that feels like checking into a five-star hotel. We stripped the room down to the studs, waterproofed every surface, ran new plumbing, and laid heated stone tile from wall to wall.
spaBathroom.description2: A walk-in rain shower, a freestanding soaker tub, custom oak vanity, and warm-LED mirror lighting. Delivered in five weeks with zero call-backs.

familyHouse.title: Family House Renovation
familyHouse.summary: A two-story 220 m² family house being renovated room by room — kitchen and main floor done.
familyHouse.description1: A young family bought a 1990s two-story house in Dighomi and asked us to bring it into 2025. We started with full rewiring and a new HVAC system, then moved on to the kitchen and main floor.
familyHouse.description2: Phase 2 — bedrooms, bathrooms, and the garden room — is currently underway. The family stays in the house throughout, which means clean dust barriers and predictable working hours.
